title: Concept: Body element carrying an inline load handler
description: A body element with an inline onload handler in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The handler executes as soon as the document loads, so it runs before any interactive control and without a user action.
applicability: Deployments that render a body element with an inline onload handler into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The handler executes as soon as the document loads, so it runs before any interactive control and without a user action.
